clean_silver_filter.input: the frozen silver build: parser/silver/silver_<list>_all.jsonl (serialised compact targets of the k%-trained structural top-1 parse) and the frozen keep decision
clean_silver_filter.execution: re-execute each stored serialised target exactly as pk_silver.py: validate_compact -> kpct_executor.compact_to_parse(c, question, None) -> Executor(<subset>).execute(probs='given') (operators + retrieval + RULE ordering; no structural hypotheses appended)

conditions.C0_frozen_keep: valid AND official hit@1 of the padded RULE list (= the frozen keep; replay-checked against the stored row)
conditions.C1_nonempty_pool: pool_size > 0, i.e. the operator / retrieval candidate pool BEFORE output padding is nonempty
conditions.C2_unpadded_top1_gold: the first pool candidate in RULE order (execute()['candidates'][0]['answer'], before padding) is in the gold set under official MultiTQ matching (multitq_eval.hit_at_k on the one-element list: a time prediction is truncated to the gold granularity YYYY / YYYY-MM before set membership), the same matching as the registered P target rule and the dev metric

clean_silver_filter.keep: valid AND C1 AND C2; otherwise the target is dropped
counts_reported: additionally dropped by C2 among C1 rows
clean rows not in the frozen set (expected 0)

lists.k01_s0: filter applied; the clean training file is written (P_1clean)

diagnostics_not_used_for_filtering: strict exact-string membership of the unpadded top-1 in the gold list (no granularity truncation)
target qtype vs released qtype; target granularity vs released time_level (all rows and time-answer rows)

clean_silver_filter.train_data_rule: only k01_s0 train answers enter the clean P_1 training set (k05/k10/k100 answers are read for the counts only, each within its own registered list)

training_recipe.identical_to: frozen P_1 (rule arms.P_k.lora_recipe = arms.G_k): Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; LoRA r 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; AdamW lr 2e-4, wd 0, cosine, 3% warm-up, grad clip 1.0, effective batch 16, bf16; loss on JSON tokens; same prompt (P_HEAD sha256 5186ca8f...), chat template date '26 Jul 2024'; max length 2,048; E_max = 3 (k = 1); seed 0 (LoRA init and data order); micro-batch limit 8,192 padded tokens; checkpoints ep1, ep2, ep3
training_recipe.code: pk_train.py of the frozen run plus an --order_seed option whose default reproduces the frozen data order exactly (used only by P_1order)
training_recipe.hardware: one RTX PRO 6000 card per process, model.to('cuda:0'), no device_map, tkgqa-gpu:latest + peft 0.21.2 (as frozen)

dev_evaluation.split: dev_sel2000 (2,000 questions, registered sha256 b5b8a28d...); no other dev question; no test question
dev_evaluation.decoding: vLLM (tkgqa-vllm:latest), greedy, max 160 new tokens, logprobs=0, one session for all 9 checkpoints
dev_evaluation.execution: pk_execute.py with the frozen settings: compact_to_parse with the k01_s0 structural hypotheses appended, probs='classifier', the 3 S_k LightGBM seeds of k01_s0 (executor/models/k01_s0/S_seed{0,1,2}.txt), fallback to S_k's own dev prediction (preds/k01_s0/dev_sel2000_S_seed{b}.jsonl) for invalid JSON / unknown name / empty pool / mean log-prob < tau
dev_evaluation.primary_configuration: ep3 and tau off for every variant (= the frozen P_1 configuration), fixed a priori; no selection is used for the primary contrast
dev_evaluation.secondary_configuration: the registered P selection (checkpoint x tau in {off, -0.30, -0.10, -0.03}, best mean Hits@1, ties -> earlier checkpoint then off) applied to each variant; descriptive only

metric.primary: dev_sel2000 Hits@1, per-question hit = mean over the 3 S_k seeds of the official hit (multitq_eval.hit_at_k, sha256 1f85bbdcd623f1810e9df2910e042c24d6f5c269d278e82b30ef05387a1e2d69)
secondary: Hits@1 on dev templates unseen in k01_s0 (bundle template_unseen flag, n = 1,446) and on the seen complement
Hits@1 by released qtype (dev metadata used only to stratify the report)
number of dev questions whose 3-seed hit changes; number of identical ep3 generations vs frozen; adapter sha256 equality of P_1rerun vs frozen

statistic.bootstrap: paired Poisson(1) over the 2,000 dev_sel2000 questions, B = 2000, seed 0 (tkg-claims-protocol paired_poisson_bootstrap, copied verbatim); two-sided 95% percentile CI; one-sided p = share of bootstrap deltas <= 0 (and >= 0 for the opposite direction); single-arm CI = the same bootstrap of the mean; the same weights for every contrast (they depend only on n and the seed)
statistic.multiplicity: one primary contrast; no correction; everything else descriptive

labels.CLEAN_HIGHER: CI(D_clean) lower bound > 0 AND D_clean > N

qualifiers.RETRAIN_REPRODUCED: P_1rerun changes no dev question's 3-seed hit vs frozen
qualifiers.DEV_FAILURE: any variant's ep3/off Hits@1 < 0.30 or invalid rate > 0.20 (after the one allowed bug-fix iteration)

labels.interpretation: Dev only and post hoc. A label qualifies the F1 label-quality caveat; it does not replace frozen P_1, its test predictions or any KP label. No test number of any variant is produced.

gpu_coordination: the GPU host: the robustness probe and other users have priority. Before each GPU container: nvidia-smi and docker ps are logged; a card is used only if memory.used < 2000 MiB and utilization < 5% in two reads 30 s apart and no compute process is on it; one process per card; never stop or touch other processes; if no card is free wait 600 s and re-check (<= 48 checks, then NOT_RUN). Orphan check after each container (no cs_* container left).

stop_rules.STOP_BUDGET: no GPU container if track spend + its projection > 2.0 GPU-h or usage log total + projection > 52
stop_rules.STOP_NO_TEST: no test question of any variant is decoded, executed or scored; the driver has no test phase; the freeze asserts that no test file exists
stop_rules.STOP_REPLAY: if any re-executed frozen keep decision (C0) differs from the stored silver row, stop before writing the clean training file and report
stop_rules.STOP_RERUN_DRIFT: if P_1rerun's data_order_sha256 or silver sha256 differs from frozen P_1's, stop before decoding and report (the rerun would not be a replicate)
stop_rules.STOP_INTEGRITY: frozen P_1 adapter and dev prediction hashes are re-verified against freeze_P_k01_s0.json before the comparison; mismatch -> stop
stop_rules.STOP_LEAK: clean silver quids must be a subset of the k01_s0 list (asserted in pk_train); dev answers are read only for the 2,000 dev_sel2000 quids and only in pk_select / cs_compare
stop_rules.STOP_DEV_FAILURE: ep3/off Hits@1 < 0.30 or invalid rate > 0.20 for a variant -> one logged bug-fix iteration, then reported as is
stop_rules.failures: an infrastructure failure may be retried once after a fix; a second failure -> that variant NOT_RUN
